scope: Bounded source review and mocked offline protocol tests; no inference, native build, actual benchmark child, or large asset hashes.
closed_findings: All post-Popen exceptions, including interruption or a start-receipt write failure, kill/reap the owned child before rethrowing.
Validation checks an externally supplied plan digest against the bytes parsed, before execution and at bracket end.
Fixed control-before/candidate/control-after build roles, three measured repetitions, runtime/limit settings, and complete bound-file inventory are checked.
Historical baseline goes through the full same-workload report validator, and its exact signatures are rechecked at launch.
Preparation compares rustc/Cargo versions, Cargo argument suffix and selected build environment except target directory, in addition to the source difference being only src/kernels.rs.

coverage: Wrong supplied plan digest rejected before input work
Changed job build role or repetitions rejected

measurement_review: Frozen harness times recognize_batch only; verified load and file decoding precede warmups and measured recognitions.
Harness verifies token IDs/text/stops across measured repetitions; wrapper validates every measured result and exact historical signature.
Candidate gains compare against both bracketing controls; absolute control drift is gated at5%, candidate target at5%; no automatic promotion.
limits: Two warmup recognitions are not independently exported or checked against historical outputs; all_measured_outputs_exact correctly scopes the claim to three measured repetitions.
Build attestation remains the underlying capture's selected source/tool/environment provenance, not a hermetic native-dependency toolchain proof.
One fixed full page and three measured repetitions support only the declared bounded candidate experiment, not broad workload or platform promotion.
